subject: Cannot login on RStudio support site with Shinyapps login

messages.author: 03bca22033b52d6e
messages.subject: Cannot login on RStudio support site with Shinyapps login
parts:
Hi,
We've just suscribed to the standard plan at shinyapps.io

I am looking for the place to report (minor) issues. 
The help button on top of my shinyapps account redirects to http://shiny.rstudio.com/
At this location where I click again on help I end up at http://shiny.rstudio.com/help/ 
This 3rd page tells me to get to https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us
However, once there, apparently I cannot use my existing shinyapps account to login in order to post a new support ticket.

Any tip?
Do I need to create a separate Rstudio account to be able to report Shinyapps.io issues?
It would be good if support is directly accessible from the shinyapps account page without having to browse through 3 different sites (the shinyapps one, the shiny one and the rstudio support one).

Thanks for your help.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Cannot login on RStudio support site with Shinyapps login
parts:
Fabrice,

You are correct. Currently shinyapps.io and our support system DO NOT share a login, so you will need a separate account for shinyapps.io support.

For customers with paid plans, the easiest way to report issues is to email shinyapp...@rstudio.com which will open a ticket for you.

-Andy
